Path 3, securityGOALS §9

External Secrets, Infisical, Vault, OpenBao

A sync layer first, so the secret store becomes a reversible choice.

WHAT IT IS

External Secrets Operator syncs secrets from any backend into Kubernetes Secrets. Infisical is an open-core secrets platform with agent-aware features. OpenBao is the Linux Foundation fork of Vault.

WHAT SETS IT APART

ESO decouples workloads from the store, so changing stores is a config change. Infisical has the friendliest UX; OpenBao is the drop-in path from Vault with an open licence.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt ESO now; decide the store after inventorying long-lived secrets. The direction is fewer long-lived secrets at all. On no path, but on a clock.

"Kubernetes Secrets Were a Bad Idea. Now What?" (RBC); Infisical demo, KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

External Secrets, Infisical, Vault, OpenBao: A sync layer first, so the secret store becomes a reversible choice. Where we stand: Adopt ESO now; decide the store after inventorying long-lived secrets. The direction is fewer long-lived secrets at all. On no path, but on a clock. Sequencing turns a strategic decision into a preference.
